name: gpu-neural-inference
description: Optimize and validate MLP and Transformer inference on NVIDIA GPUs.

interface.shortDescription: Optimize GPU MLP and Transformer inference.
interface.longDescription: Guidance for isolated inference benchmarking, model microbatch and concurrency tuning, fused Transformer hot paths, offline low-precision export, SM120 block-scaled NVFP4/MXFP4 execution, and task-level quality validation.
defaultPrompt: Design and validate an SM120 low-precision inference path.
